violations.reason: The agent asserted that certificate_4314329 "was fully consumed when used for Trip A (travel certificates are not refundable/reusable)." The available tool results show only that the certificate had a $250.0 amount and that $100 was charged to it for Trip A; neither the user nor the tools state that a certificate is fully consumed or non-reusable after a partial charge. The policy states only that the remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable, so the agent's broader claim is unsupported information.

violations.policy_requirement: - All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
violations.description: - All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
violations.reason: The Trip B book_reservation call included certificate_4314329 as a payment method, but the resulting tool error was "Payment method certificate_4314329 not found," and the subsequent user profile no longer lists certificate_4314329. Since the policy requires every payment method used in a booking to already be in the user profile, attempting to book Trip B with a payment method that was not in the profile violates this payment rule.
